name: three-api-pattern
description: Polymarket has 3 APIs: Gamma (market discovery, no auth), Data (positions/trades, no auth but needs wallet address), CLOB (orderbook public + authenticated trading). CLOB tools require token_id (per-outcome), never conditionId (per-market). py-clob-client handles HMAC/EIP-712 signing.

name: demo-mode-guard
description: demo.py provides require_live_mode() which returns a JSON error string in DEMO mode or None in live mode. Every write tool calls this at the top and returns early if demo. Read-only tools never call it. subscribe_market works in demo (no auth), subscribe_orders does not.
